'''Goh's Golurk''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのゴルーグ ''' ''Go's Goloog'') is the third {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Unova]] [[region]], and his twenty-seventh overall. It is a [[giant Pokémon]].

==In animation==
===History===
===={{aniseries|JN}}====
[[File:Golurk Raid Egg.png|thumb|left|250px|Golurk's Raid Egg]]
Golurk debuted in ''[[JN014|Raid Battle in The Ruins!]]'', where [[Goh]] and {{Ash}} visited the [[Unova]] [[region]] to explore the [[Colossus Ruins]] in the [[Desert Resort]]. After hatching from an ancient egg, it engaged in a [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]] with Ash, Goh, {{OBP|Kira|JN014}}, and the excavation {{OBP|leader|JN014}}. After a hard-fought battle, Goh eventually managed to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} it. Afterward, it was seen in the [[Cerise Laboratory]], interacting with Goh's other {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}.

In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', while trying to stop a fight that broke out between the other Pokémon during a food shortage, the seal on Golurk's chest was knocked off, causing it to go berserk. Ash and Goh kept Golurk distracted while {{TP|Goh|Skwovet}}, {{TP|Goh|Farfetch'd}}, {{TP|Goh|Cubone}}, and {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Pidgey}} put the seal back on. It then helped protect the {{p|Cascoon}} from the flood caused by its rampage, allowing them to [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Dustox}}.

In ''[[JN038|Restore and Renew!]]'', Goh used Golurk to help him dig up [[Fossil]]s at the [[Pewter Museum of Science]]. Later, when an {{p|Aerodactyl}} revived from an [[Old Amber]] Goh had found went out of control, Goh sent out Golurk to battle it after {{TP|Goh|Raboot}} had been defeated. Golurk was eventually able to stop Aerodactyl's rampage, after which Goh was able to convince {{TP|Goh|Aerodactyl}} to let him catch it.

In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Golurk joined the rest of Goh's Pokémon at the lab to celebrate their Trainer's return from the [[JN133|last]] [[JN134|mission]] of [[Project Mew]]. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', it attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. After that, it posed for a group photo with Goh, Ash, and the others.
{{-}}

===Personality and characteristics===
[[File:Golurk unsealed.png|thumb|250px|Golurk with its seal removed]]
Golurk is a [[giant Pokémon]], being much larger than other Golurk. It is very powerful; during the [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]] in ''[[JN014|Raid Battle in The Ruins!]]'', it managed to take down all of the opposing Pokémon and land hits on [[Goh's Darmanitan]] and [[Ash's Dragonite]]. In battle, Golurk forgoes precise attacks, preferring to use its long-range attacks like {{m|Flash Cannon}} in sweeping arcs. Under Goh's control, it was able to use its size and power to withstand several hits from a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{TP|Goh|Aerodactyl}}, biding its time until it could land a punishing blow with {{m|Hammer Arm}}.

Despite its considerable size and strength, it is a gentle giant outside of battle, as seen during its interactions with some of Goh's other Pokémon at the [[Cerise Laboratory]], and doesn't seem to mind the other Pokémon resting on it while it is relaxing. In ''[[JN038|Restore and Renew!]]'', Golurk was shown to be mindful of its own strength, heaving a large boulder out of the way for Goh and the others before gently fitting a much smaller stone between its fingertips to examine it for [[fossil]]s. If the seal on its chest is removed, its energy runs wild, with the energy's color turning from yellow to red as it rampages. While on a rampage, it can cause significant damage to its surroundings, and cause torrential rainfall, just like the move {{m|Rain Dance}}.

It also shows a desire to protect Pokémon, as shown when it protected Goh's three {{p|Cascoon}} that were about to get hit with an {{m|Overheat}} attack from Darmanitan.

===[[Pokémon GO]]===
On November 6, 2020, as part of Pokémon GO's [https://pokemongo.nianticlabs.com/post/animationweek2020/?hl=en Animation Week 2020] event, which was based on {{aniseries|JN}}, several Pokémon based on those that Ash and Goh encountered in the animated series appeared more frequently in the wild, in {{GO|Raid Battle|raid}}s, from 7 km [[List of Eggs in Pokémon GO|Eggs]], and during [[Photography#Pokémon GO|surprise encounters]], with Golurk appearing only in level 3 raids. The event ran from November 6, 2020, at 8:00 a.m., to November 12, 2020, at 10:00 p.m. local time.
